input.free_text_description: This system is a microservices platform that serves Candidate roles. The platform provides capabilities for person, tip not found handler, tip. Secondary concerns include job/recommendation functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Candidate, I want to interact with clients functionality, so that I can accomplish my clients-related tasks.
As a Candidate, I want to interact with person functionality, so that I can accomplish my person-related tasks.
As a Candidate, I want to interact with tip functionality, so that I can accomplish my tip-related tasks.
As a Candidate, I want to use person capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Candidate, I want to use tip not found handler capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
